messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.05-1
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.05-1) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org).

A major bug was found regarding permutations with scanone and scantwo
in the case of covariates.  Such covariates should be permuted along
with the phenotypes, but hadn't been.

See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a complete list of changes.

The package is on its way to CRAN (http://cran.r-project.org); the
Windows version of the package is not yet posted but will be soon.

As always, I'd appreciate hearing any suggestions or comments or
complaints.

Karl Broman
kbr...@jhsph.edu

messages.subject: genotypic means
messages.body_plain:
now that scan one is updated, how do you get the phenotypic means from
interval mapping?

Previously, after interval mapping of an F2 cross the result was a
matrix containing the means for A, H, and B for each position used in
the interval mapping.  In the pdf, i see a way to plot effects, but i'd
like to get the matrix.

thanks,
david

messages.subject: Re: genotypic means
messages.body_plain:
Eventually, such estimates will be obtained via fitqtl(), but that's
currently only working for imputation.

For now, such estimates may only be obtained via fitqtl() or
effectplot(),
and only via imputation.

karl
